questions.question: Explain what a planet is and why the Earth is a planet.
questions.expected_answer: A planet is a big, round object in space that travels around a star. The Earth is a planet because it is a big, round object that travels around the Sun, which is our star.

questions.question: Name what we can see in the sky in the day and at night.
questions.expected_answer: In the day we can see the Sun, and sometimes the Moon. At night we can see the Moon, the stars and some planets, which look like bright stars that do not twinkle much. On a dark night we can also see the Milky Way.

questions.question: Explain why stars look like tiny dots even though they are huge.
questions.expected_answer: Stars are giant balls of hot, glowing gas, and many are as big as the Sun or bigger. They look like tiny dots because they are very, very far away from the Earth. The Sun looks big because it is the closest star to the Earth.
